summary: Git-backed routing, context compilation, durable memory, skill discovery, and handoff infrastructure for coding agents.
current_priorities: P0.0: Make Agent OS the default preflight/context/routing layer for every supported ChatGPT chat, Work project, coding-agent task, and connected agent surface. Supported clients should automatically consult Agent OS; partially supported clients should use the thinnest possible capture/handoff bridge.

P0.1: Implement the Staged Workflow Orchestrator. Break complex jobs into bounded stages, use the cheapest appropriate capability per stage, validate/checkpoint each stage, stop cleanly, and emit the exact next prompt plus recommended capability/model/reasoning effort.
P0.2: Implement selective profile/context retrieval with compact context packets, relevance filtering, deduplication, privacy enforcement, provenance, and measurable context-size diagnostics.

P0.3: Implement shared document intelligence: local persistent extraction/OCR cache, embedded-text-first routing, dependency-aware invalidation, template reuse, targeted field-zone OCR, and strict work-data privacy boundaries.

P0.4: Generalize restart-safe checkpoints, stable IDs, fingerprinting, deduplication, and incremental processing for long-running imports/crawls including iCloud Mail, Drive archive work, text imports, document batches, and future knowledge ingestion.
P0.5: Operationalize deterministic/cache/approved-skill-first execution and make the staged orchestrator use that policy before model calls.
Then add privacy-safe usage telemetry, adaptive routing with validator-driven escalation, automation mining, skill mining, and prompt/context optimization.

After the usage-economy foundation is working, implement the Personal Executive roadmap: Event Bus, Next Action Engine, capture/rescue, prioritization, delegation, communication/calendar intelligence, proactivity, voice, and controlled autonomy.

Keep Knowledge Library / Elder Scrolls and Lorekeeper / creative intelligence as later reusable systems that inherit universal routing, staged execution, selective retrieval, incremental ingestion, caching, provenance, and adaptive routing.
constraints: Canonical state must remain reviewable in Git.
Do not preload raw history or all project content.
A third-party MCP must not claim to hot-swap the host model already running inside ChatGPT Work or Claude; use pre-routing, delegation, and Agent-OS-owned escalation instead.
